card.title: The menu, as printed
course.birch-caviar.blurb: Eleven days of tapping a stand of birch north of Alingsås, reduced to a syrup, bound at half a per cent alginate and dropped pearl by pearl into a chilled calcium bath. Three hundred pearls. One spoon. There is no second spoon.
course.birch-caviar.name: Birch Sap Caviar
course.birch-caviar.pairing: None. It would be in the way.
course.cloudberry-frozen.blurb: Cloudberries picked by one family in Norrbotten who will not tell us where. Frozen into a sphere first so the skin sets round a solid and the middle thaws back to fruit at the table — the first cold thing since the birch, and your palate will make a point of noticing.
course.cloudberry-frozen.name: Cloudberry, Frozen Reverse
course.cod-nitro.blurb: The collar — the part the fishmonger keeps for himself — cured four days in barley koji, then the butter sauce is frozen round it at −196 °C and shatters on the spoon. Eaten with your hands. There is a cloth. You will need the cloth.
course.cod-nitro.name: Cod Collar, Koji, Nitro
course.gravel.blurb: Not gravel. Chocolate, buckwheat and black malt spheres, tempered and rolled in cocoa aerogel to match the aggregate in the floor you are standing on. Six guests have eaten the floor. We have stopped correcting them.
course.gravel.name: Gravel
course.marrow-pearls.blurb: Marrow roasted at 240 °C until it surrenders, then dropped as pearls into a lingonberry fluid gel sheared out of low-acyl gellan. The berries are left sour on purpose, because something on this plate has to have standards.
course.marrow-pearls.name: Bone Marrow Pearls, Lingonberry
course.oyster-reverse.blurb: A Bohuslän oyster goes back inside a sphere of its own liquor. Reverse spherification, because the oyster brings calcium of its own and a direct bath would set it through to the middle — which is a firm oyster, which is not an oyster.
course.oyster-reverse.name: Oyster, Reverse-Spherified
course.reindeer-smoke.blurb: Sarek reindeer, aged twenty-one days, under a sphere inflated with juniper smoke that is broken at the table. A neighbour once called the fire brigade about the embers. It was worth it. He agreed later, at this table, over this course.
course.reindeer-smoke.name: Reindeer, Juniper Smoke Sphere
course.rutabaga-400.blurb: A swede buried in salt for longer than most restaurants stay open, pressed to a consommé and set into a single ravioli sphere that holds until it reaches 62 °C and then does not. It tastes like a memory of beef. Guests cry. We have stopped asking why.
course.rutabaga-400.name: Rutabaga Sphere, 400 Days
course.rye-espuma.blurb: The bread course, taken apart. Thirty-six hours of sourdough becomes an air held up on soy lecithin; Tuesday’s churned butter becomes a gel set with agar at two grams a litre. It weighs almost nothing and people still fill up on it.
course.rye-espuma.name: Rye Air, Cultured Butter Gel
footer.colophon: A kitchen by RMH Studios. Closed July and the week of midsummer.
globe.desc: A glass sphere with the nine courses set on it as pearls, each drawn at the size it is served. Drag to turn it, press it to send a wave across the surface. The same menu is listed as text beside it.
globe.hint: Drag to turn it · pearls are drawn to size
hero.lede: Nine courses, every one of them a sphere, in a foundry hall that bent reinforcing steel for thirty-five years.
menu.title: Turn the globe.
page.lede: A molecular-gastronomy kitchen in a decommissioned rebar foundry. Nine courses, every one of them a sphere. One root vegetable that has been through considerably more than you have.
page.title: Rebar & Rutabaga
policy.allergies.body: Tell us when you book, not when you sit down. We will cook around very nearly anything, with one exception: a dislike of rutabaga is a personality matter and we cannot plate around it.
policy.allergies.title: Allergies
policy.children.body: Over twelve, welcome. Under twelve will be bored, and then so will you, and the room carries sound beautifully.
policy.children.title: Children
policy.floor.body: Six guests have attempted to eat the floor after course nine. It is not edible. The dessert is. We have stopped correcting people mid-bite.
policy.floor.title: The floor
policy.lateness.body: We hold the table for fifteen minutes. The kitchen is a queue, not a suggestion — course three has been in the bath since you parked.
policy.lateness.title: Lateness
policy.photographs.body: Take as many as you like. At nine per cent they will all come out brown, and we have made our peace with that.
policy.photographs.title: Photographs
premise.body: When we took the foundry over, everyone told us to warm it up — something on the walls, carpet, a smaller light. We took the walls back to lime plaster instead, kept the board-formed concrete with the patches where the rebar cages sat, and hung twenty-four bulbs at nine per cent. Then we built a menu that could survive in here. Every course is set into a sphere: bound with alginate, dropped into a calcium bath, and held until it is bitten. It is the same trade as the one this building was built for — something liquid, given a shape it keeps until it is put under load.
premise.title: The hall bent steel for thirty-five years. Now it bends liquids.
room.caption: Materials schedule — foundry hall, rev. C
room.lede: Everything in the hall was either here in 1963 or chosen to admit that it was not. Nothing is distressed and nothing pretends.
room.M-01.spec: Board-formed concrete, original, 1963. Patched where the rebar cages sat. Not polished, and never will be.
room.M-02.spec: Lime plaster over brick, unpainted. Two sections left raw at the client’s insistence. The client is the chef.
room.M-03.spec: Blackened mild steel, 12 mm, waxed. Cold to the touch. We know. It is deliberate.
room.M-04.spec: Steam-bent ash, oiled, no upholstery. Sourced within 40 km. Comfortable for exactly two hours and fifty minutes.
room.M-05.spec: 24 × 40 W tungsten, dimmed to 9 %. This is the part with the star.
room.M-06.spec: Wool felt baffles in the roof trusses. You can hear your own table and none of the others.
room.M-07.spec: Stainless, 4.8 m, heated. Visible from every one of the 24 seats, on purpose, at all times.
room.M-08.spec: Calcium chloride, 0.5 %, held at 4 °C behind glass. Nine courses start in it. Guests watch. This was not the original plan.
room.M-09.spec: Retained, 6.2 m above floor. Load-tested. Decorative. Do not ask us to hang anything from it.
room.title: The room, scheduled.
